rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's fourteen builder trees go (magnolias, jacarandas, ficus and eucalyptus along the back fences, a norfolk pine and a magnolia 3 m from the house fronts); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the grill, on the open lot corner, and in three back yards 6-7 m from the houses.

trees.why: the back yard with the kettle grill (1.6 m off): a jacaranda over the cook
the open lot corner at the north-west, 24 m from the walls: a full jacaranda
the middle back yard, 6 m from the house, 40 m from the grill tree
the east back yard of the south row, 7 m from the house
the same row 51 m west, 6 m from the house: a young eucalyptus
